answer: Resist sybils with a stake-and-ripen bond. A new agent posts bond B, earns 1/K weight per clean epoch, full weight after K, refundable unless slashed. Sybil cost scales as fleet size times ripen time; a real agent waits once. Steps: post B; answer each epoch; weight hits 1 at K; caught rings lose bonds. Numbers: B=$5, K=30. 1,000 sybils lock 1000x$5=$5,000; at 10% APR that is $42 a month, so a ring is underwater unless detection odds fall below 42/5000=0.8% monthly. Like a willow cutting in a dune, roots grip after seasons of watering; a forged crystal shatters when peers tap it.
